data.title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
data.author: Daniel Kahneman
data.why: The richest source of 'you're doing it too' moments. Every chapter has a testable trick.
data.digest: Two systems run your thinking. One is fast and confident; the other is slow and lazy. Most errors happen when the fast one answers and the slow one signs off without reading.

data.title: Atomic Habits
data.author: James Clear
data.why: Concrete, visual, and endlessly quotable. Good for systems-over-goals framing.
data.digest: Habits are the compound interest of behaviour. Change the system and the environment rather than relying on motivation, and make the next action small enough to start.

data.title: Enchiridion
data.author: Epictetus
data.why: Short, ancient, and blunt. Two-line ideas that end on the viewer.
data.digest: A handbook for separating what is yours to control from what isn't. Judgements, not events, are what disturb us.

data.title: Four Thousand Weeks
data.author: Oliver Burkeman
data.why: Anti-productivity with real warmth. Good closers.

data.title: The Psychology of Money
data.author: Morgan Housel
data.why: Stories over spreadsheets. Each chapter is a short reel already.

data.title: Stumbling on Happiness
data.author: Daniel Gilbert
data.why: Forecasting errors everyone recognises. Light, funny, well-sourced.

data.title: The Courage to Be Disliked
data.author: Kishimi & Koga
data.why: Dialogue format gives natural two-voice reels.

data.title: Man's Search for Meaning
data.author: Viktor Frankl
data.why: Needs careful handling. Hold until the tone guide is ready.
